Ava: Morning handoff — quick set of things to watch before I sign off at 10:15am PT.
Ava: TL;DR: canary deployed to eu-west at ~02:10, watch embed queue + prefetch experiment on dedicated pool, PR review ping for kv-cache tweak. Links: https://grafana.internal/redwood/embeds and runbook: https://wiki/redwood/oncall.
Sam: I can take primary watch. If embed queue > 800, scale policy -> bump pool to 4 nodes and open the bridge.
Riley: FYI I'm OOO after 10:30am PT — @Neha will cover pager for my lanes.
Maya: I noticed ~2% KV evictions in the last hour on canary. I added a temporary alert rule (eviction_rate > 1.5%). Will watch retention and prefetch hit-rate.
Jorge: PR #4123 (kv-cache LRU adjustment) is ready for review, tests pass. pinging @Ava for approval before EOD.
Ava: @Jorge thanks. I'll sanity-check perf numbers (10:05am) and approve if stable.
Sam: Re rollback plan: if tail latency > 500ms for 5m or error rate > 0.8%, run rollback playbook step 2. Quick command to scale down canaries: `infractl deploy scale --env=eu-west --name=canary --replicas=0`
Neha: Copy — I'll claim any pages while Riley is OOO. Added a temporary prefetch override to the canary config: `curl -XPOST https://config.internal/api/set -d '{"prefetch.enabled":false}'` (will revert after confirm).
DeployBot: [deploy] canary/eu-west started by Ava — commit 8f3c9d1 · timestamp 2025-03-18T02:09:12Z
Maya: Also added a note in the channel about increased retry counts around 01:50 — could be noisy callers. If you see >=3% retry rate, escalate.
Sam: I'll monitor retries and latency, and open the bridge if both cross thresholds.
Ava: Action items: (1) Sam — primary watcher + rollback readiness, (2) Maya — retention/evictions, (3) Neha — pager coverage for Riley gap, (4) Jorge — hold for final approval after perf check.
Jorge: Understood. I'll stand by and respond to quick comments.
Riley: Thanks all — leaving everything in good shape, Neha has my handoff notes in Confluence.
Ava: Ok leaving the handoff to Sam/Maya. Ping me @phone-only if it's an S2 or worse. :coffee:
Neha: Got it — will call if anything looks like a regression.
Sam: Acknowledge. Starting 15m focused watch window now.
Ava: thanks — will check back in after my 10:05 sanity check.
